title: Xinke's Math Academy
text:
This is a small math academy headquartered in Alabama for interested math students, both in Alabama, and around the world. All classes are currently taught online. It is run by Xinke Guo-Xue, an MIT graduate and former AoPS and MIST Academy student. More information can be found on Xinke's website: [1].

Xinke Guo-Xue is also currently running the Alabama ARML team selection process.

Students interested in trying out for Alabama ARML or taking classes from Xinke's Math Academy can contact him at xinkeguoxue@gmail.com.
